newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, except dipping fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, except dipping fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Monday, except for fuel oil, which dipped as Friday's support faded, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were unchanged from last week's close, but up from the lowest trades seen towards the end of Friday's session.
One barge traded at $194 fob Rotterdam. Little business was expected until NYMEX unleaded futures opened this afternoon. A number of traders said they expected a slight upward correction.
"The fall in the U.S. did not reflect what is really a tight (stocks) situation in the States," one trader said.
Heating oil barges were tentatively offered at IPE May +75 cents/+$1 fob Rotterdam, but the closure of the IPE forestalled most trading.
High sulphur fuel oil barges dipped by $1 as Friday's main prop, a Rotterdam-based major, was no longer buying. Best prompt offers were at $82.50 fob Rotterdam, best bids at $81.50.
Initial bunker enquiries were under 10,000 tonnes.
